items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: I was talking to John Porter and John Porter told me he was in town a few weeks ago.

ctx.x: And I never did see that man no more.

And he came in. I was talking to John Porter and John Porter told me he was in town a few weeks ago. Some place they played up here somewhere. And John Porter, he went home and passed away. He just had told me, he said his heart was bad anyway. Because we was kidding. He said, now there's Jim, he's making his money. And he's not playing. See, when they played the student watches, Jim had to cut out. He wasn't knowing that.
That was a tuxedo band. Yeah.
